plan.problem: Desk main-only editing conflicts with protected main; guide-only updates omit existing CI and guide test has cross-realm false failure; old verification language can be misread.
plan.currentContract: Protected staging main requires PR and immutable first-commit Plan Lock. Desk validates staging identity and confirms a time-limited editing session. Guide Ready already lives in Release Validator. Final VERIFIED is deferred.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Desk pins active branch to main and sync to origin/main; Guide source and test are absent from CI paths; older doc text promotes record validation to VERIFIED.
plan.design: Reuse identity marker as default-branch identity, validate selected branch separately, compare HEAD to origin of that branch, bind session and show branch. Extend existing CI paths and commands. Clarify current state without altering trusted checker contracts.
plan.migration: No repository marker/schema or runtime content migration. Old Desk sessions must reconfirm selected branch.
plan.compatibility: Retain production rejection, marker validation, manual File Provider workflow with explicit branch declaration and immutable Change OS contracts.
plan.rollback: Revert implementation commit on staging through normal PR; no settings or production rollback needed.
plan.promotionRisk: No production promotion or settings change authorized.
